Survey research for your studies

Source: vignettes/articles/learn/for-students.Rmd
for-students.Rmd

This page is for a student conducting a survey for a course, a dissertation or a thesis. It takes you from an example study to your own report. Your supervisor and ethics committee may ask for the documents named at each step.

Your steps

  1. Set up. Install R, RStudio and surveyframe as the Get started page shows.
  2. Choose an example close to your study. The questionnaire templates are grouped by field. Each holds a questionnaire and an example analysis plan to adapt.
  3. Adapt the questionnaire. Open the example in SurveyStudio, edit the questions on the Design screen and press Save to Studio. Question types explains which question fits each kind of answer.
  4. Write your analysis plan. On the Plan screen, record each research question, what you expect to find, the measurements and the method. The analysis plan explains each part.
  5. Share the plan before collecting. On the Report screen, press Export pre-analysis plan and give it to your supervisor or ethics committee with the .sframe file.
  6. Collect and check responses. The Collect screen gives you the survey web page. Load the responses on the Responses screen and review them on the Quality screen.
  7. Analyse and report. Run the planned analyses on the Analyse screen, write your interpretation and export the APA 7 report. If you changed the plan, the report lists each amendment with its reason.

Further guidance

  • Run a study in SurveyStudio, each stage with screenshots
  • Run a study in R, for the same stages in code
  • How-to guides, by analysis task
  • Register your plan on OSF, if your course asks for a preregistration
